summary: Seabridge Gold Inc. filed a Form 6-K with its 2025 Sustainability Report, detailing ESG performance across its North American gold and copper projects. The filing is a routine annual disclosure with no transaction, no share issuance, and no special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The report covers safety metrics, environmental compliance, reclamation progress, community partnerships, and governance improvements. No deal terms apply.
